title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Opening Theme Song, July 7 Premiere
content: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day anime revealed a new visual featuring the main cast along with a new trailer, opening theme song, and a July 7 premiere date. ReoNa is singing the opening theme song titled “Amore.” Yumi Uchiyama and Ai Kayano are also joining the cast as Fran and Omi, respectively.
author: Anime Corner

title: Meili's Backstory Revealed in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 10 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 10 (Episode 76 overall) preview ahead of its June 10, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season , as well as the Week 6, Week 8 , and Week 9 . Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Mamoru Miyano as Cyborg 002
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Tuesday that Mamoru Miyano will voice Cyborg 002/Jet Link in the series. Cyborg 002 can fly at the speed of Mach 5. Yūki Kaji plays the anime's main character Joe Shimamura/Cyborg 009.
author: ANN

title: Ensemble Stars! Music Producer Satoru Kuwabara Resigns After Acknowledging Allegations of Affairs
content: The idol exposé poster Deathdol Note uploaded reports and photos onto social media last Thursday, alleging that musician and music producer Satoru Kuwabara had affairs with numerous women over at least the past two years.
author: ANN

title: Way of the Househusband Manga Gets New 'Special' Anime Video
content: The official YouTube channel for Shinchosha 's Comic Bunch brand began streaming a new "special" anime promotional video for Kousuke Oono 's The Way of the Househusband ( Gokushufudō ) manga. The video shows a scene not shown in the manga, with Tatsu raiding a rival gang's headquarters in his past life as a yakuza.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Dengeki Daisy' Gets TV Anime Adaptation in 2027
content: Production company Aniplex opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy manga on Tuesday, revealing the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will begin airing in 2027. Staff Director: Souta Ueno ( Gimai Seikatsu , Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
author: MyAnimeList

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Reveals Episode 10 Preview
content: MARRIAGETOXIN anime revealed the Episode 10 preview images and synopsis ahead of the episode’s June 9 release. Studio BONES Film is handling the animation production, which premiered on April 3 . Crunchyroll is streaming the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kyousuke Motomi's Dengeki Daisy Shōjo Manga Gets TV Anime by Studio Deen
content: A teaser website opened on Tuesday to announce the television anime adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy shōjo manga. Aniplex first teased a countdown for an announcement on Monday.
author: ANN
